problem_statement.original_question: Determine all integer pairs (x, y) that satisfy the Diophantine equation x^2 - x = y^5 - y.
problem_statement.self_contained_problem: Determine all pairs of integers (x, y) in Z x Z that satisfy the Diophantine equation x^2 - x = y^5 - y. That is, find every integer solution of the equation, and prove that the list is complete.
